subject: Chemical reprogramming extends lifespan in worms, reverses aging hallmarks in human cells
script: From Agewell Brief: Chemical reprogramming extends lifespan in worms, reverses aging hallmarks in human cells. A two-molecule cocktail induces partial reprogramming, restoring genomic stability and reducing senescence, opening a new path to anti-aging therapy. Chemical cocktail improves genomic instability and epigenetic alterations in aged human cells. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
